name: Multimonitor Background
author: frueh
description: Omarchy's background service, extended for several monitors: a wallpaper can bring a left and a right panel, so one scene runs across three screens or each side screen shows a picture of its own. An editor lets you drag and zoom the picture on every screen, and autoscale matches it to each monitor's physical size.

barWidget.description: Opens the editor: drag and zoom the background on every monitor.
